messages.linkedin.connection.auth-help: Use a LinkedIn OpenID member token with openid and profile. Listing posts requires Community Management access and returns 403 for most developer apps. The connection is considered healthy when userinfo succeeds.
messages.linkedin.connection.inbound: API reads the OpenID member profile
messages.linkedin.guide.token-note: Use an OpenID member access token. Posts require separate approval.
messages.linkedin.oauth.note: Enable Sign In with LinkedIn in the app. Standard OIDC does not provide permission to read posts in Feed.
